messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-2892 fired for service=\"inference-gateway\" — 5xx rate spike > 2% over 5m in region=us-west1. Check dashboards: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/PD-2892
pagerduty: Paging on-call: @alex.g @mei.wu. Escalation policy = infra-prod -> 2min.
alex.g: acked. I'm looking at the gateway logs now. Pulling last 10m.
mei.wu: also seeing error spike on endpoints that hit kv-cache. 502 and 504 mix, looks like upstream disconnects.
sanjay: tagging infra — any infra churn / node reboots in us-west1 in the last 30m?
liz_h: no scheduled infra work. I see an automated config reload from infra-bot ~16m ago (nginx keepalive tweak). Might be related.
alex.g: running quick grep: ```kubectl logs -l app=inference-gateway -n prod --since=15m | egrep \"502|504|upstream connect\" | tail -n 50
[2026-03-15T10:21:03Z] error: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: remote reset
[2026-03-15T10:21:07Z] proxy error: 502 from backend kv-cache-1: read timeout
[2026-03-15T10:23:11Z] warn: circuit to kv-cache-3 tripped: consecutive failures=7
```
mei.wu: that aligns with the metrics: backend 502s are concentrated on kv-cache-3 and appear simultaneous with a pod restart spike. p95 tail latency for gateway is normal which points to backend flakiness rather than overloaded gateway.
sanjay: checking node/pod state: ```kubectl get pods -n prod -l component=kv-cache -o wide
kv-cache-1   2/2 Running   0   10m   10.1.12.8
kv-cache-2   1/2 CrashLoop  3   12m   10.1.12.9
kv-cache-3   0/2 CrashLoop  6   9m    10.1.12.10
```
alex.g: CrashLoops on kv-cache-2/3 — they're returning connection resets, that explains the spike. Is the autoscaler kicking new nodes?
liz_h: infra shows memory pressure on two nodes hosting kv-cache pods. Might be OOMs from a GC change in the latest kv-cache release rolled 25m ago.
oncall-rotation: what's the mitigation plan? Customers are seeing intermittent failures. We should failover traffic away from the bad pool and rollback kv-cache release if it's confirmed.
alex.g: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) route traffic away from pool containing kv-cache-2/3; 2) rollback kv-cache release to previous revision; 3) scale up healthy kv-cache replicas temporarily. I can flip routing if we agree.
mei.wu: +1 to routing away and scaling. Also let's warm a small in-memory fallback for hot keys to reduce backend pressure.
sanjay: executing route change: `redwood route set-pool inference-gateway pool-usw1-degraded --weight 0 --env prod` — applying now.
deploy-bot: route change accepted. Pool pool-usw1-degraded weight -> 0. Active connections draining (~30s).
alex.g: rolling back kv-cache to revision v1.4.8 (deployed 03/15 09:30). Triggering rollout.
deploy-bot: rollback started for deployment kv-cache -> target revision v1.4.8. 3/3 pods updated. Health checks passed.
mei.wu: monitoring metrics after actions. Initial signal: 5xx rate dropping from 3.7% -> 1.1% within one minute. Still watching for tail.
incident-bot: PD update: PD-2892 status=acknowledged by alex.g, severity=SEV2 -> team is performing rollback + traffic routing.
oncall-rotation: customer-impact check: our analytics show ~0.9% of total requests in us-west1 experienced 5xx during the 10:20-10:25 window; a small number of enterprise customers (approx 7 accounts) reported timeouts via support. No SLA breaches detected yet but we should notify CS.
liz_h: informing CS/Support channel now: "brief outage window affecting requests in us-west1; mitigation applied; engineering investigating further" :email:
sanjay: scaling healthy kv-cache pool +2 replicas to absorb load while we validate rollback. `kubectl scale deploy/kv-cache --replicas=5 -n prod` done.
alex.g: confirms error rate now steady at 0.12% (background) — looks resolved. I'll keep watch for 15m and then close pager.
mei.wu: recording quick notes for postmortem: suspect regression in kv-cache release (GC / memory tuning) + interaction with config reload (keepalive). Need repro test and rollback gating.
incident-bot: PD update: PD-2892 status=resolved (resolution: routing rollback + scale).
oncall-rotation: thanks everyone. Please file a short postmortem and list action items: (1) revert risky GC change from kv-cache release pipeline; (2) add perf test for keepalive+kv-load; (3) improve alerting to annotate backend pod restarts in the 5xx alert.
alex.g: filing incident ticket now. I'll add logs and timeline. Great work team. :thumbsup:
liz_h: closing note — support will reach out to the 7 customers impacted with a heads-up.
mei.wu: final checkin — monitoring for 20m, p95/p99 all normal now. :white_check_mark:
